False friends — these match the words but not the capability, so do
not list them:
- Downgrade entity-coreference work unless it explicitly resolves propositions, events, facts, situations, clauses, discourse segments, or other abstract antecedents.
- Downgrade event-coreference work that only clusters mentions of the same event and never models a response relation to the event or proposition.
- Downgrade dialogue-act or speech-act classification if the task labels the current utterance but does not identify which prior span or proposition the act targets.
- Downgrade agreement/disagreement classifiers if the target is implicit, fixed, whole-turn, whole-message, or supplied as gold and no target-selection evaluation is performed.
- Downgrade stance work when the target is a predefined topic, named entity, politician, product, hashtag, or supplied claim rather than an antecedent selected from preceding discourse.
- Downgrade NLI, entailment, contradiction, semantic-similarity, or fact-verification work when the sentence pair or evidence proposition is already supplied and antecedent discovery is absent.
- Downgrade QA and reading-comprehension work when the question is supplied as gold and the system only extracts or generates an answer.
- Downgrade conversational-QA work that merely answers a sequence of questions and never aligns one response to a subset of simultaneously pending questions.
- Downgrade partial-answer work that means partial credit, truncated output, missing knowledge-base facts, or answer-quality scoring rather than partial resolution of a prior question or issue.
- Downgrade email threading, reply-header reconstruction, quotation extraction, and conversation disentanglement when they recover message-level structure but not semantic response scope.
- Downgrade email response generation, smart reply, response-time prediction, and reply recommendation; these predict or generate a reply rather than identify its antecedent scope.
- Downgrade discourse-relation classification when relation arguments are supplied as gold and the model is not evaluated on attachment or argument-span selection.
- Downgrade monologic discourse parsing unless its argument-selection or multi-antecedent machinery is clearly transferable; do not count it as direct workplace response evidence.
- Downgrade adjacency-pair or conversation-analysis work if it establishes only sequential organization without annotating or operationalizing proposition-level targets.
- Downgrade generic workplace-communication or organizational-communication research without computational or empirical annotation of responses and antecedents.
- Downgrade approval literature from access control, legal authority, regulatory approval, procurement workflow, or authorization systems unless it analyzes natural-language approval targets.
- Downgrade studies that force exactly one antecedent when the data can contain no antecedent, missing context, ambiguity, multiple valid antecedents, or composite antecedents, unless the limitation itself is explicitly analyzed.
- Downgrade systems evaluated only at message or turn level when the project-critical error is partial proposition scope and no finer-grained analysis is provided.
- Downgrade papers that report relation labels but cannot distinguish a response applying to one clause from the same response applying to the entire preceding message.
- Downgrade synthetic or non-workplace evidence from DIRECT target-domain status; it may remain useful as TRANSFER or engineering evidence but cannot establish production-email behavior.
- Do not treat a reply-to edge as sufficient evidence of semantic scope: a message-level reply may contain responses to only one of several propositions or may introduce unrelated content.
- Do not treat absence of a predicted link as equivalent to a missing antecedent unless the annotation scheme distinguishes no-link, unsupported, missing-context, and model uncertainty.
- Do not treat multiple candidate antecedents as an error by definition; retain literature that explicitly models genuine ambiguity, composite antecedents, or simultaneous multiple links.
- Prefer studies whose gold representation contains antecedent spans, discourse units, propositions, or explicit links; downgrade studies where the target relation can only be inferred indirectly from a coarse label.
Reach back to 1973 at least. Discovery should reach at least 1973 because adjacency-pair and sequence-organization work in conversation analysis established foundational notions of paired actions and conditional relevance that underlie question-answer, request-acceptance/refusal, and response relevance. Computational and formal work closer to the current proposition-reference problem becomes especially important from the late 1980s and 1990s onward, including grounding, discourse deixis, abstract discourse objects, and later dialogue discourse parsing. A search beginning only in the 2000s or a recent-year window would silently exclude these foundations. Bulk computational discovery can prioritize 1990-present, but the canonical-acquisition pass must permit 1973-present.
